== Documentation ==
The documentation comments for this script come from the <code>DefaultAliasOnShipTakeOff.psc</code> source file.

<source>
Sets stage when THIS Alias takes off.
<QuestToSetOrCheck> is THIS Alias's GetOwningQuest()
<LocationToCheck> is the current location of THIS Alias's reference.
</source>
